# Contributing

Thanks for taking an interest in Aether Vials: Arcane Brew.

This repository is primarily maintained as a portfolio project. Bug reports and focused suggestions are welcome through GitHub Issues. Before opening an issue, please check whether a similar report already exists.

When reporting a problem, include:

- the affected level;
- the device or simulator model;
- the iOS version;
- the steps needed to reproduce the behavior;
- a screenshot or screen recording when the issue is visual.

Please do not submit third-party artwork, audio, or other assets unless you have the right to redistribute them.
